purpose: gnsslad11 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 151): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..10 then NEW step 11 (2 s console pause first): + FIRST GPS-bus reads (0x18c0103c, 0x18c73108, USRT L1). Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
